dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「え、そ、それは、その……。わ、私と、その
　……」
dialogues.en:
"M-My heart's beating fast because we're going on a
date......"
dialogues.text:
"M-My heart's beating fast because we're going on a
date......"

dialogues.jp: 胸を押さえ、呟く。
dialogues.en: She touches her chest and mutters.
dialogues.text: She touches her chest and mutters.

dialogues.jp: 「どれどれ」
dialogues.en: "Let me see."
dialogues.text: "Let me see."

dialogues.jp:
などと言いつつ手を伸ばしてみるが、さすがに
実行はしない。
dialogues.en:
I reach my hand toward her chest and pretend that I'm going
to touch it to check her heart.
dialogues.text:
I reach my hand toward her chest and pretend that I'm going
to touch it to check her heart.

dialogues.jp:
「ま、そりゃね、俺だってドキドキしてるよ。
　サボるのとは、また別の部分で」
dialogues.en:
"Of course my heart is beating fast because of that, too.
It's just a different part of my heart."
dialogues.text:
"Of course my heart is beating fast because of that, too.
It's just a different part of my heart."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ほ、ほんと……ですか？」
dialogues.en: "R-Really......?"
dialogues.text: "R-Really......?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「触ってみる？」
dialogues.en: "Do you want to touch it?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want to touch it?"

dialogues.jp:
胸の部分をトントンと叩いてみる。頼子さんは
赤い顔をして首を振った。
dialogues.en:
I tap my chest. Her face turns red and she shakes her head
no.
dialogues.text:
I tap my chest. Her face turns red and she shakes her head
no.

dialogues.jp:
緊張ならするに決まっている。“デート”と正
式に銘打って出かけた事が、果たして俺の人生
であったのやら……。
dialogues.en:
Of course I'm nervous. I've never gone out with a girl in my
life as an official date.
dialogues.text:
Of course I'm nervous. I've never gone out with a girl in my
life as an official date.

dialogues.jp: 「でもさ……」
時計に目を向け、俺は言った。
dialogues.en: I look at my watch and say,
dialogues.text: I look at my watch and say,

dialogues.jp: 「……何で、こんな時間から出発するの？」
dialogues.en: "......Why are we going out so early?"
dialogues.text: "......Why are we going out so early?"

dialogues.jp:
デートって、だいたい夕方とか、早くても昼く
らいからするものじゃないだろうか？
dialogues.en:
Usually I think dates start in the evening, or at least from
lunchtime.
dialogues.text:
Usually I think dates start in the evening, or at least from
lunchtime.

dialogues.jp: 短針の先にある数字は──９。
dialogues.en: But the short hand right now is pointing at -- 9.
dialogues.text: But the short hand right now is pointing at -- 9.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「朝早くから出かけて……目一杯遊びたいなと
　思ったんです」
dialogues.en:
"I wanted to go out in the morning and...... enjoy the whole
day."
dialogues.text:
"I wanted to go out in the morning and...... enjoy the whole
day."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「おお」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp: 頼子さんにしては積極的な意見に、嬉しくなる。
dialogues.en: I'm happy to hear her positive suggestion.
dialogues.text: I'm happy to hear her positive suggestion.

dialogues.jp: 「でも、どこ行こうか？」
dialogues.en: "Where do you want to go?"
dialogues.text: "Where do you want to go?"

dialogues.jp:
急なことで、いい場所を調べるような時間はな
かった。
dialogues.en:
I didn't have enough time to do a search for good places to
go.
dialogues.text:
I didn't have enough time to do a search for good places to
go.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、昨日考えたんですよ。これ、見て下さい」
dialogues.en:
"I was thinking about it last night. Please take a look at
this."
dialogues.text:
"I was thinking about it last night. Please take a look at
this."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「どれどれ？」
dialogues.en: "Let me see?"
dialogues.text: "Let me see?"

dialogues.jp:
渡してきたメモに目を遣る。何だか、文字でいっ
ぱいだ。
dialogues.en:
I look at the piece of paper she hands me. It has a lot of
writing on it.
dialogues.text:
I look at the piece of paper she hands me. It has a lot of
writing on it.

dialogues.jp: 「……えーと、頼子さん？」
dialogues.en: "......Ummm... Yoriko-san?"
dialogues.text: "......Ummm... Yoriko-san?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「はい、何でしょう？」
dialogues.en: "Yes, what is it?"
dialogues.text: "Yes, what is it?"

dialogues.jp:
その罪のない笑顔に、何やら背筋に｛けつろ／結露｝が生じ
てしまう気分。
dialogues.en: Her innocent smile makes a chill run up my spine.
dialogues.text: Her innocent smile makes a chill run up my spine.

dialogues.jp: 「これは、えと、この中から選べってこと？」
dialogues.en: "Do you want me to pick one place from these?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want me to pick one place from these?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「はい？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
きょとんと、首を傾げる。……あ、やっぱり違っ
たか。矢印で場所が繋がってるもんなあ。
dialogues.en:
She tilts her head in question. ......That means I was
wrong. I sort of knew I was wrong because I see arrows
connecting each of the places.
dialogues.text:
She tilts her head in question. ......That means I was
wrong. I sort of knew I was wrong because I see arrows
connecting each of the places.

dialogues.jp: メモを爪で弾きながら、確認した。
dialogues.en:
Rapidly stroking the paper with my fingers, I confirm with
her.
dialogues.text:
Rapidly stroking the paper with my fingers, I confirm with
her.

dialogues.jp:
「これに書かれているの、全部回ろうって、そ
　ういう計画？」
dialogues.en: "Your plan is to go through all of these places?"
dialogues.text: "Your plan is to go through all of these places?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そうですけれど……」
dialogues.en: "Yes, that's right......"
dialogues.text: "Yes, that's right......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「出発→ウインドウショッピング→映画鑑賞→
　プラネタリウム→水族館→持参のお弁当で昼
　食→遊園地→カラオケ→音楽鑑賞→ｅｔｃ」
dialogues.en:
"Leave home -> Window shopping -> watch a movie -> go to the
planetarium -> Aquarium -> Eat lunch that I made ->
Amusement park -> Karaoke -> Go to a music store ->
etc......"
dialogues.text:
"Leave home -> Window shopping -> watch a movie -> go to the
planetarium -> Aquarium -> Eat lunch that I made ->
Amusement park -> Karaoke -> Go to a music store ->
etc......"

dialogues.jp:
メモは、両面に渡ってまだまだ続くのだ。月面
旅行とか書いてないだけマシと思えるくらいだ。
dialogues.en:
And it still continues to the back page. I'm relieved that
she didn't put "a trip to the moon" in the list.
dialogues.text:
And it still continues to the back page. I'm relieved that
she didn't put "a trip to the moon" in the list.

dialogues.jp: 「……これを、１日で回れと？」
dialogues.en: "......Do you want to do all of these in a day?"
dialogues.text: "......Do you want to do all of these in a day?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、その……無理、でしょうか……？」
dialogues.en: "Ah, do you think...... we can't......?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, do you think...... we can't......?"

dialogues.jp: 託宣を下すように荘厳に、俺は言った。
dialogues.en: I answer sharply,
dialogues.text: I answer sharply,

dialogues.jp: 「無理」
dialogues.en: "No way."
dialogues.text: "No way."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「あ、じゃあ、その、島の中を歩いて回りませ
　んか？」
dialogues.en:
"I understand. Then would you like to just walk around the
island?"
dialogues.text:
"I understand. Then would you like to just walk around the
island?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「え？　散歩みたいな感じで？」
dialogues.en: "What? You mean like having a walk?"
dialogues.text: "What? You mean like having a walk?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「私……島の様子はあまり知りませんから、い
　い機会だと思うんです」
dialogues.en:
"I...... haven't been to anywhere on this island yet, so I
think this will be a good opportunity."
dialogues.text:
"I...... haven't been to anywhere on this island yet, so I
think this will be a good opportunity."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「お弁当は用意してありますので、お腹が空い
　たらそれをいただきましょう」
dialogues.en:
"Since I already made lunch for us, we can eat wherever and
whenever we get hungry."
dialogues.text:
"Since I already made lunch for us, we can eat wherever and
whenever we get hungry."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……どうですか？」
dialogues.en: "......What do you think?"
dialogues.text: "......What do you think?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「ピクニックみたいなもんか。うん、いいん
　じゃないか」
dialogues.en: "It'll be like having a picnic, huh? It sounds great."
dialogues.text: "It'll be like having a picnic, huh? It sounds great."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「つっても、１日で島の全部を回るってのは、
　やっぱり無理だぜ？」
dialogues.en:
"But I want you know that there's no way we can walk all the
way around the island today."
dialogues.text:
"But I want you know that there's no way we can walk all the
way around the island today."

dialogues.jp:
最初の計画からすると、それも考えていそうで
怖い。そんな事になったら、もはや苦行である。
dialogues.en:
Taking her first plan into consideration, there was a
possibility that she might be thinking about it. If so, this
picnic would be nothing but hard labor...
dialogues.text:
Taking her first plan into consideration, there was a
possibility that she might be thinking about it. If so, this
picnic would be nothing but hard labor...

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、はい……そうですね……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, yes...... I understand......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, yes...... I understand......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「そんな、唇噛みしめて残念そうにせんで
　も……。ま、ともかく、そろそろ、出よ
　うか？」
dialogues.en:
"Please don't look so disappointed, biting your lips like
that...... Anyway, shall we go now?"
dialogues.text:
"Please don't look so disappointed, biting your lips like
that...... Anyway, shall we go now?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「まずは、島の西の方に行こうか。昼飯とるの
　に、丁度いい場所がそっちの方にあるし」
dialogues.en:
"Let's go to the west side of the island. There's a nice
place to have lunch at."
dialogues.text:
"Let's go to the west side of the island. There's a nice
place to have lunch at."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、荷物は俺が持つよ」
dialogues.en: "I'll carry the bag for you."
dialogues.text: "I'll carry the bag for you."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、すいません……」
dialogues.en: "Oh, thank you......"
dialogues.text: "Oh, thank you......"

dialogues.jp:
｛とう／籐｝で編んだカゴを受け取る。この中にお弁当が
入ってるって訳だな。
dialogues.en:
I grab a wicker basket from her. I assume it's our lunch
inside this basket.
dialogues.text:
I grab a wicker basket from her. I assume it's our lunch
inside this basket.

dialogues.jp: ……鉄アレイじゃないよな？　重いんですけど。
dialogues.en:
...She didn't put iron dumbbells in by mistake, did she?
It's so heavy......
dialogues.text:
...She didn't put iron dumbbells in by mistake, did she?
It's so heavy......

dialogues.jp:
「何だか、妙な気分だな。学園に行くのでもな
　いのに、こんな時間にこの道通るなんて」
dialogues.en:
"I feel weird walking on this road at this time but not
going to school."
dialogues.text:
"I feel weird walking on this road at this time but not
going to school."

dialogues.jp:
通学の時間からは微妙に外れているので、人影
はまばらだ。
dialogues.en:
Because it's just a little bit later than the commute time
to school, there are only a few people walking.
dialogues.text:
Because it's just a little bit later than the commute time
to school, there are only a few people walking.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あの……すいません。無理言ってしまって」
dialogues.en: "Ah, I'm sorry...... for asking you a big favor."
dialogues.text: "Ah, I'm sorry...... for asking you a big favor."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　いやあ、そんな事は……」
dialogues.en: "No, I don't mind at all......"
dialogues.text: "No, I don't mind at all......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「ほらほら。せっかくのデートなんだから、笑っ
　て笑って」
dialogues.en: "Hey, this is supposed to be a date! You have to smile."
dialogues.text: "Hey, this is supposed to be a date! You have to smile."

dialogues.jp: ほっぺたをつまんで、むにっと引っ張る。
dialogues.en:
I squeeze her cheeks with my fingers and pull them to the
sides a little bit.
dialogues.text:
I squeeze her cheeks with my fingers and pull them to the
sides a little bit.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「わ、わらえまふぇんよ……こえじゃ……」
dialogues.en: "I can't... smile... if you do that......"
dialogues.text: "I can't... smile... if you do that......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……それもそうだ」
dialogues.en: "......You're absolutely right."
dialogues.text: "......You're absolutely right."

dialogues.jp:
つるつると気持ちのいい頬から手を離し、その
まま、手を繋ぐ。
dialogues.en: I let go of her smooth cheeks and hold her hand.
dialogues.text: I let go of her smooth cheeks and hold her hand.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「デートデート」
dialogues.en: "This is a date, remember?"
dialogues.text: "This is a date, remember?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「でも、いい天気で良かったよな」
dialogues.en: "I'm glad the weather is perfect today."
dialogues.text: "I'm glad the weather is perfect today."

dialogues.jp:
目を細め空を見上げる。変わらぬ桜がそこにあ
り、青を背景に花びらが舞い散っていた。
dialogues.en:
I squint and look up at the sky. There are the familiar
cherry blossoms dancing in the blue sky.
dialogues.text:
I squint and look up at the sky. There are the familiar
cherry blossoms dancing in the blue sky.

dialogues.jp: 「ピクニック日よりというか……」
dialogues.en: "This is a great day for a picnic......"
dialogues.text: "This is a great day for a picnic......"

dialogues.jp:
ポカポカと穏やかな陽気だし、風もない。ほん
と、いい日。
dialogues.en:
The temperature's warm and there's no wind. It's such a nice
day.
dialogues.text:
The temperature's warm and there's no wind. It's such a nice
day.

dialogues.jp:
「これであいつらが居なけりゃ最高なんだが
　……」
dialogues.en: "It would be perfect if only they weren't here......"
dialogues.text: "It would be perfect if only they weren't here......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あの人達……何ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Who are those people?"
dialogues.text: "Who are those people?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「いやあ、配給を待っているんだろう」
dialogues.en: "I think they're waiting for their food allowances."
dialogues.text: "I think they're waiting for their food allowances."

dialogues.jp:
校門の内側に、体操服姿の学生がわらわらと集
まって来ていた。
dialogues.en:
There are many students wearing gym clothes coming toward
the school gate.
dialogues.text:
There are many students wearing gym clothes coming toward
the school gate.

dialogues.jp:
その一番先頭に立ち、背後の連中を引き連れて
いるような格好を取っているのが──、
dialogues.en: And the person standing in front of everybody is...
dialogues.text: And the person standing in front of everybody is...

dialogues.jp: （さすがわんこ。鼻が利きやがる……）
dialogues.en: (Just like a dog. She does have a good nose......)
dialogues.text: (Just like a dog. She does have a good nose......)

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「あ……手を振ってます。お知り合い……です
　か？」
dialogues.en: "Ah... She's waving at you. Do you know her......?"
dialogues.text: "Ah... She's waving at you. Do you know her......?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「いやあ、空腹のあまり幻覚でも見てるんだろ。
　さ、さっさと行こうぜ」
dialogues.en:
"No, I think she's just hallucinating because she's so
hungry. Let's just go."
dialogues.text:
"No, I think she's just hallucinating because she's so
hungry. Let's just go."

dialogues.jp: 半ば小走りで、校門の前を通り過ぎる。
dialogues.en: We walk fast and pass in front of the gate.
dialogues.text: We walk fast and pass in front of the gate.

dialogues.jp:
せんぱ〜い、だなんて声が聞こえたようにも思
うが、ほっとこう。
dialogues.en:
I think I heard someone calling my name but I pretend I
did't hear anything.
dialogues.text:
I think I heard someone calling my name but I pretend I
did't hear anything.

dialogues.jp: 「さて、と。ここら辺が、だいたい島の西側だ」
dialogues.en: "So, this is the west side of the island."
dialogues.text: "So, this is the west side of the island."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……こっちの方に来るのは初めてですね……」
dialogues.en: "......It's my first time coming here......"
dialogues.text: "......It's my first time coming here......"

dialogues.jp:
何の変哲もない道だが、それでも珍しいらしく、
扇風機のように辺りを見回している。
dialogues.en:
There's nothing interesting about this road we're walking
on, but it seems like there's something interesting to her.
She's looking around with curiosity.
dialogues.text:
There's nothing interesting about this road we're walking
on, but it seems like there's something interesting to her.
She's looking around with curiosity.

dialogues.jp:
「さらに島の端まで行くと、工業地帯があるん
　だけど……。行ってみる？」
dialogues.en:
"If we go all the way to the end, there's an industrial
area...... Would you like to go there?"
dialogues.text:
"If we go all the way to the end, there's an industrial
area...... Would you like to go there?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp:
何がそんなに楽しいのか、頼子さんは笑顔でう
なずく。
dialogues.en:
I've no idea why she's having so much fun, but she nods with
a big smile.
dialogues.text:
I've no idea why she's having so much fun, but she nods with
a big smile.

dialogues.jp: （……いや、俺も楽しいか）
dialogues.en: (......Wait a minute... I'm having fun, too...)
dialogues.text: (......Wait a minute... I'm having fun, too...)

dialogues.jp: 頬が、笑みの形に弛んでいるのが分かる。
dialogues.en: I can tell my cheeks are shaped in a smile.
dialogues.text: I can tell my cheeks are shaped in a smile.

dialogues.jp:
二人一緒なら、どこだって楽しい。まあ、そう
いうことだろう。
dialogues.en:
Anything can this so much fun when a couple is together. I
guess that's what's happening to us right now.
dialogues.text:
Anything can this so much fun when a couple is together. I
guess that's what's happening to us right now.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「島の西側は、大分景観が違うんですね……」
dialogues.en: "The view looks so different from the west side......"
dialogues.text: "The view looks so different from the west side......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ま、工業地帯だしね。住宅街とは違うわな」
dialogues.en:
"Plus, this is an industrial area, so it should look
different from a residential area."
dialogues.text:
"Plus, this is an industrial area, so it should look
different from a residential area."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「何だか、面白かったです……」
dialogues.en: "It was so much fun......"
dialogues.text: "It was so much fun......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「昔、社会科見学に行ったけど、それを思い出
　したな」
dialogues.en: "I remember I came here once for a field trip."
dialogues.text: "I remember I came here once for a field trip."

dialogues.jp: 私もです、と言って頼子さんは笑った。
dialogues.en: Same here, she says with a smile.
dialogues.text: Same here, she says with a smile.

dialogues.jp: 「さて。では、そろそろ待望の昼飯にしようか」
dialogues.en: "Well, let's eat the lunch we've been waiting for!"
dialogues.text: "Well, let's eat the lunch we've been waiting for!"

dialogues.jp: 弁当の入ったカゴを持ち上げる。
dialogues.en: I lift up the lunch basket.
dialogues.text: I lift up the lunch basket.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「どこか、ベンチにでも座って、いただきます
　か？」
dialogues.en: "Should we find a bench to sit down to eat?"
dialogues.text: "Should we find a bench to sit down to eat?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「いや、それよりいい場所があるんだ。そこへ
　行こう」
dialogues.en: "No, I know a good place."
dialogues.text: "No, I know a good place."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「わあ、この島に、こんなにいい場所があった
　んですね……」
dialogues.en:
"Wow...... I didn't know there was such a beautiful place on
this island......"
dialogues.text:
"Wow...... I didn't know there was such a beautiful place on
this island......"

dialogues.jp:
眼下に広がる街並みを前に、頼子さんは子ども
みたいなはしゃいだ声をあげた。
dialogues.en:
Looking at the town below us from the hill, she squeals with
delight like a child.
dialogues.text:
Looking at the town below us from the hill, she squeals with
delight like a child.

dialogues.jp:
高台には、少しだけ風が吹いていて、陽気に汗
ばんだ肌に気持ちが良かった。
dialogues.en:
There's a soft wind blowing on the hill, and it feels good
to our slightly sweaty skins.
dialogues.text:
There's a soft wind blowing on the hill, and it feels good
to our slightly sweaty skins.

dialogues.jp:
「夜景だったら、もっと綺麗だったんだろうけ
　どね」
dialogues.en:
"It would have been more beautiful if we came here at
night."
dialogues.text:
"It would have been more beautiful if we came here at
night."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「今のままでも、充分ですよ……」
dialogues.en: "This is beautiful enough for me......"
dialogues.text: "This is beautiful enough for me......"

dialogues.jp:
遠い目をして、風に語りかける。綺麗だな、と
思った。そこだけ空気が違うのだ。
dialogues.en:
She talks to the wind, squinting. I think she looks so
beautiful. The atmosphere's different around her.
dialogues.text:
She talks to the wind, squinting. I think she looks so
beautiful. The atmosphere's different around her.

dialogues.jp:
大げさに言って、俺の視界において、頼子さん
の周りだけ、周囲から切り抜かれている。
dialogues.en:
If I can use exaggerated language, I would say it looks to
me as if she's cut out from the view.
dialogues.text:
If I can use exaggerated language, I would say it looks to
me as if she's cut out from the view.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「さ、お昼をいただきましょう」
dialogues.en: "Let's eat lunch now."
dialogues.text: "Let's eat lunch now."

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんの顔に見とれていた俺は、ただ頷くこ
としか出来なかった。
dialogues.en:
I can only nod back to her because I'm admiring her beauty
so much.
dialogues.text:
I can only nod back to her because I'm admiring her beauty
so much.

dialogues.jp: どこか腰を下ろせそうな場所を探した。
dialogues.en: We look for a place we can sit down to eat.
dialogues.text: We look for a place we can sit down to eat.

dialogues.jp:
「う……もう、腹いっぱい。ごちそうさまでし
　た」
dialogues.en: "I'm so full. Thank you so much, Yoriko-san."
dialogues.text: "I'm so full. Thank you so much, Yoriko-san."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「お粗末様です」
dialogues.en: "I am glad you liked them."
dialogues.text: "I am glad you liked them."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「しかし……ずいぶん、たくさん作ったね……」
dialogues.en: "But...... you made a lot......"
dialogues.text: "But...... you made a lot......"

dialogues.jp:
腹を押さえつつ、空になった弁当箱を見る。そ
れはなんと、お重だった。四段積みの。
dialogues.en:
I hold my tummy and look at the empty lunchbox. Actually
it's lunchboxes, 4 boxes...
dialogues.text:
I hold my tummy and look at the empty lunchbox. Actually
it's lunchboxes, 4 boxes...

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「どうせなら、たくさん作ろうと思ったんです。
　……でも、ちょっと、多すぎたみたいですね」
dialogues.en:
"I thought I might as well make a lot when I make one.
......But I guess I did make a little too much......"
dialogues.text:
"I thought I might as well make a lot when I make one.
......But I guess I did make a little too much......"

dialogues.jp: ちょっと、というか凄くだ。
dialogues.en: A little? No, it was way too much.
dialogues.text: A little? No, it was way too much.

dialogues.jp:
「でも、美味しかった。頼子さん、ほんと上達
　したよな……」
dialogues.en:
"But they tasted so good. Yoriko-san, you're getting so much
better......"
dialogues.text:
"But they tasted so good. Yoriko-san, you're getting so much
better......"

dialogues.jp:
言いながら、ごろんと地面に横になる。用意は
周到で、ビニールシートが敷いてある。
dialogues.en:
I lie down on the ground. She's all prepared and has a vinyl
sheet to lie down on.
dialogues.text:
I lie down on the ground. She's all prepared and has a vinyl
sheet to lie down on.

dialogues.jp: 「あ〜……しばらく動けそうにないかも」
dialogues.en: "Oh...... I don't think I can move for a while."
dialogues.text: "Oh...... I don't think I can move for a while."

dialogues.jp: しかも、この春の陽気だ。何だか、眠い。
dialogues.en: And this spring perfect weather is making me sleepy as well.
dialogues.text: And this spring perfect weather is making me sleepy as well.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉さん」
dialogues.en: "Junichi-san."
dialogues.text: "Junichi-san."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「その……こちらへどうぞ」
dialogues.en: "Ah...... you can lie down here."
dialogues.text: "Ah...... you can lie down here."

dialogues.jp: ぽんぽんと、自分の膝を叩いた。
dialogues.en: She patted on her knees.
dialogues.text: She patted on her knees.

dialogues.en: "......Are you sure?"
dialogues.text: "......Are you sure?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「来てくれないなら……こちらから行っちゃい
　ます」
dialogues.en: "If you don't use my knees...... I'll come and make you."
dialogues.text: "If you don't use my knees...... I'll come and make you."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、遠慮なく」
dialogues.en: "Okay, then I will take it."
dialogues.text: "Okay, then I will take it."

dialogues.jp: ずりずりと肘で這い、頼子さんの膝を目指す。
dialogues.en: I crawl toward her knees.
dialogues.text: I crawl toward her knees.

dialogues.jp: 「到着、と」
dialogues.en: "Here I am."
dialogues.text: "Here I am."

dialogues.jp: その柔らかな感触に、頭を納めた。
dialogues.en: I put my head on her soft thighs.
dialogues.text: I put my head on her soft thighs.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「眠たくなったら、寝てくださいね」
dialogues.en: "You can sleep if you want."
dialogues.text: "You can sleep if you want."

dialogues.jp:
そんな声を聞きながら、意識がすっと遠くなる
のを感じていた……。
dialogues.en:
Listening to her voice, I feel my mind starting to fall
asleep......
dialogues.text:
Listening to her voice, I feel my mind starting to fall
asleep......

dialogues.jp: ◆デート◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp: 学校をさぼって頼子さんとのデート。
dialogues.en: "What? Is it because...... you and I are......"
dialogues.text: "What? Is it because...... you and I are......"

dialogues.jp:
俺たちは島の内部をぐるりと色々と見て回る事
にした。
dialogues.en: "You and I are going out on a date......?"
dialogues.text: "You and I are going out on a date......?"

dialogues.jp:
桜公園の高台で一息ついて昼飯を食べると、な
んだか眠くなってくる。
dialogues.en: "No, it's because I am skipping school today."
dialogues.text: "No, it's because I am skipping school today."

dialogues.jp:
俺は頼子さんの膝枕で眠りの世界へ誘われて行っ
たのだった。
